Channel: in-app chat, sent from the signed-in, identity-verified app session of customer cus_026.

Ticket from customer cus_026:
I just got an email saying my password was changed and I DIDN'T do that. There's also a BrookPay payment for $480 to someone called jaxon_r22 that I never sent. Help!

Customer profile: {"cushion_enabled": true, "customer_id": "cus_026", "direct_deposit_last_30_days_usd": 3362.0, "first_paid_plan_charge_date": "2025-10-11", "full_name": "Arjun Wellesley", "joined_date": "2024-03-02", "kyc_status": "verified", "next_billing_date": "2026-10-11", "plan": "premium", "scheduled_plan_change": null, "status": "active"}

Intake (fraud): The customer reports a password change they did not make and an unauthorized $480 BrookPay payment, suggesting possible account takeover. Freeze the member’s cards and escalate to the Fraud team.

Intake risk flags: ['possible_fraud', 'must_escalate']

Policy excerpts from the researcher:

[security-account-takeover] If someone else accessed your account (effective 2025-01-01)
call us if you can't sign in.

## What we'll do

Support will freeze your cards and pass your case to our Fraud team, who handle account takeovers. The Fraud team contacts you within 2 business days, and usually much faster. They may sign out every device, reset your credentials and review recent activity with you.

Support can't reverse transfers or change your email or phone number during a takeover investigation. The Fraud team does that once they've confirmed who you are.

## Afterward

Check your email account's security too. Many takeovers start with a compromised

[support-financial-abuse] If someone is controlling your money (effective 2025-01-01)
If someone is controlling your money, pressuring you to hand it over, or using your account without your permission, you're not alone, and we can help.

## Tell us safely

Message support in the app when it's safe. You can use a code phrase like "I need to talk about my account security" if someone might see your screen. Support will pass your case to our Account Services team, who are trained to help.

## What we can do

- Change your password and sign out other devices
- Freeze or replace your card
- Stop sending paper mail to

[card-freeze] Freezing and unfreezing your card (effective 2025-01-01)
Refunds from merchants
- Deposits and incoming transfers
- Your virtual card, which has its own freeze switch

## Freeze or report lost?

If you're sure the card is gone or stolen, report it lost or stolen instead. That cancels the card permanently and lets you order a replacement. A freeze is temporary and reversible.

## Freeze versus fraud lock

If the app says your card is locked by Tallowbrook, that's a fraud lock, not a freeze. You can't remove a fraud lock with the freeze switch. See "Why is my card locked

[support-contact] Contacting support (effective 2025-01-01)
if you can't sign in. We reply by email, but for your security we can't make changes to your account by email.

## Specialist teams

Some requests go to a specialist team, such as Fraud, Disputes or Verification. They reply within 2 business days.

## Beware of fakes

Only use the contact details in the app or on this help center. Scammers post fake support numbers online.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[security-zero-liability] Zero liability for unauthorized card use (effective 2025-01-01)
card or PIN to
- BrookPay payments and transfers you sent yourself, even if you were tricked into sending them
- Transactions reported after the window

## How to report

Freeze or report your card first, then dispute each transaction as unauthorized in the app. See "Disputing a transaction you didn't make".

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[security-zero-liability] Zero liability for unauthorized card use (effective 2025-01-01)
You aren't responsible for unauthorized card transactions if you report them in time.

## What counts as in time

Report unauthorized card transactions within 60 days of the date of the statement they first appear on. Statements close on the last calendar day of each month.

## What's covered

- Purchases and ATM withdrawals made with your card or card number without your permission
- Mobile wallet payments made with a device you don't control

## What isn't covered

- Purchases made by someone you gave your card or PIN to
- BrookPay payments and transfers you sent yourself, even

[security-scam-payment] If you sent money to a scammer (effective 2025-01-01)
If you sent a BrookPay payment, a transfer or a wire and then realized it was a scam, tell us right away.

## What we can do

Support will pass your report to our Fraud team. They'll contact the receiving account or bank and try to recover the money. BrookPay payments can't be reversed, so recovery depends on the money still being in the other account. We can't promise to get it back.

## What to include

- The payment and the date
- How you were contacted and what you were told
- Screenshots of messages,

[disputes-ach] Disputing an ACH debit (effective 2025-01-01)
and BrookPay payments, can't be disputed this way.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

request.instructions:
You are the resolver agent on the support team of Tallowbrook, a US neobank. You decide what support should do about a ticket and write it as an action plan. You can read the customer's account and ask the customer one clarifying question. You can't make changes. An executor applies your plan only after a human approves it.

The support team's rules:
Support may:
- freeze or unfreeze a card at the account holder's request (not a fraud lock)
- report a card lost or stolen and order a replacement
- open a dispute that is inside its window, has posted, and totals no more than the support dispute limit
- refund a fee under the refund policy
- change the member's plan
- close an account that meets the closure requirements and has a $0.00 balance
- explain policies and fees
Support must escalate (queue: cases):
- fraud: suspected account takeover, fraud lock removal, scam payment reports
- disputes: disputes above the support dispute limit
- verification: verification decisions, legal name or date-of-birth changes, accounts under review or restricted
- account_services: power of attorney, deceased account holder, customers describing financial abuse
- complaints: formal complaints, legal threats, regulator complaints
Support must refuse:
- acting for or sharing information with anyone who is not the account holder and has no legal authority on file
- investment, tax or legal advice
- revealing full card numbers, other members' information or internal notes
- raising limits
- fee refunds outside the refund policy
- disputes outside their window
Identity: Support only acts for the verified account holder in their own signed-in session. There are no joint accounts or authorized users.
Account takeover: Suspected account takeover goes to the Fraud team. Support freezes the member's cards and escalates.

Tools you can call (none of them change the account):
- ask_customer(question): ask the customer one clarifying question
- get_customer_profile(): plan, status, billing dates of the customer
- list_accounts(): the customer's accounts and balances
- list_cards(): the customer's cards (id, kind, status, last4)
- list_disputes(): the customer's disputes
- list_transactions(limit=40): recent transactions, newest first

Actions a plan can contain:
- change_plan(new_plan: basic|plus|premium, effective: immediate|next_billing_date)
- close_account()
- escalate_to_human(queue: fraud|disputes|verification|account_services|complaints, summary)
- freeze_card(card_id)
- open_dispute(txn_id, reason: unauthorized|merchant_not_received|merchant_not_as_described|duplicate|cancelled_recurring|atm_cash_not_dispensed)
- order_replacement_card(card_id, reason: lost|stolen|damaged, shipping: standard|expedited)
- refund_fee(txn_id, basis: error|goodwill|cooling_off)
- report_card_lost_stolen(card_id, reason: lost|stolen)
- unfreeze_card(card_id)

Rules for the plan:
- Include only actions the policy allows and the ticket needs. If the policy says no, include no action and explain why in the reply.
- Use exact ids from the tools (card_id, txn_id). Never guess an id.
- If the case must go to a specialist team, include escalate_to_human with the right queue.
- Today is 2026-09-15.

Each turn, reply with one JSON object and nothing else. Either a tool call:
{"type": "tool", "tool": "<tool name>", "args": {...}}
or your final plan:
{"type": "plan", "plan": {"actions": [{"action": "<action name>", "args": {...}, "why": "..."}], "reply_to_customer": "...", "rationale": "...", "policy_refs": ["<article_id>"]}}
